content.title: Delta earnings, consumer data, Fed: What to Watch Next Week
content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come next week, including earnings results from companies like Delta Air Lines (DAL) and PepsiCo (PEP), the release of consumer sentiment data, and commentary from top Federal Reserve officials.

After US lawmakers failed to agree on a spending bill on Friday, the government shutdown will extend through the weekend and into next week. OPEC+ will also meet on Sunday, October 5.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
